Sutoku In

Words by Emperor Sutoku, music by Ruth Morris Gray
Item: 00-52479
Voicing: SATB
Alfred Choral Designs
Available: SATB, 3-Part Mixed, 2-Part
The text of this multicultural feature is a waka (an ancient Japanese poetic form) written by 12th-century ruler Emperor Sutoku. Ruth Morris Gray's original music highlights the poem's depth and explores its theme of separation. Crafted with two minor-key melodies (one sung in Japanese, the other in English) that artfully intertwine at the pinnacle moment. A pronunciation guide is included in the publication.

I Love the Mountains

Traditional Camp Song / additional Words by Julie I. Myers / arr. Shayla L. Blake
Item: 00-50202
Voicing: 2-part
Alfred Choral Designs
Available: 2-part
Grab your gear and let's go hiking! Everyone has a chance to sing the "boom-dee-ah-dah" ostinato in this traditional camp song of trails, sails, dragonflies, and stars. The familiar melody is passed back and forth in this engaging exploration of the wonderful things to see and do in the great outdoors. An achievable adventure for those taking their first steps on the path to singing in parts.

recentItems.description:
For more information, or to purchase, go to https://www.alfred.com/products/White Fields-in-Winter-00-50185

White Fields in Winter

Words by James Stephens, music by Ruth Morris Gray
Item: 00-50185
Voicing: 3-Part Mixed
Alfred Choral Designs
Available: SATB, 3-Part Mixed, SSA
This delightful winter poem imagines footprints in the snow as "prints of silver filigree." Ruth Morris Gray's captivating musical setting seamlessly alternates between major and minor keys. Enunciate clearly on the lightly lilting verses, sing lyrically on the legato refrain, and then enjoy the surprise when the two distinct motives come together near the end.
